name: He-Yin Zhen
shortBio: Chinese anarcho-feminist philosopher and founder of Natural Justice (Tianyi bao) who formulated a pathbreaking historical-structural critique of nannü (the hierarchical male/female distinction) as the root of property, state, and class domination.
centralQuestion: How does the hierarchical binary category of nannü (man/woman) constitute the foundational grammar of private property, state authority, and economic exploitation?

keyWorks.title: On the Question of Women's Liberation (Nüzi jiefang wenti)
keyWorks.description: Defines true feminist revolution (nüjie geming) as the simultaneous abolition of state, capital, and Confucian patriarchal domination.

keyWorks.title: On the Revenge of Women & Economic Revolution in Women's Liberation
keyWorks.description: Deconstructs nannü as a historical regime of inequality rather than a natural essence.
